purpose: Collect immutable candidate-hour cases for the Research OS V1 shadow benchmark without allowing case multiplication, post-hoc dropping, or baseline/challenger case drift.

case_unit.definition: One canonical candidate observed in one ACTIVE-HOUR cycle with at least one legacy task that references exactly that candidate.
representative_task_rule: Prefer a Research OS scheduler-selected task linked to the candidate.
If none is selected, prefer a READY linked task.
Otherwise choose the lexicographically smallest linked task_id.
Do not create a case when no single-candidate linked task exists.
case_unit.case_id_hash: SHA256 canonical JSON, prefix ROS1, first 24 hex characters

collection_rules: Collection is read-only with respect to active factory state.
Every cycle artifact is immutable after first successful write; identical repeats are idempotent and differing repeats fail closed.
Ground truth is UNRESOLVED at capture time.
No captured case may be removed because its later outcome is inconvenient, ambiguous, negative, or still unresolved.
Unresolved mandatory cases block the final replacement comparison rather than being skipped.
Baseline and challenger observations must later bind to the exact same case_id.
The collector never authorizes trading, paid actions, wallet actions, or runtime mutation.

mandatory_cohort_rule.start: the first prospective capture explicitly accepted for the benchmark after collector validation
mandatory_cohort_rule.accumulation: include every qualifying case in chronological ACTIVE-HOUR order until the end of the first cycle where all raw minimums are met
mandatory_cohort_rule.cutoff_behavior: freeze the mandatory cohort at that cycle; later cycles are resolution-only and cannot add or replace benchmark cases

class_balance_after_resolution.if_missing: INSUFFICIENT_CLASS_BALANCE; do not extend this cohort post hoc

DECISIVE_NEGATIVE: Any required non-NA gate is explicitly FAIL; required-gate failure is non-overridable.
SURVIVOR: At least three later qualifying candidate observations from distinct accepted ACTIVE-HOUR cycles exist.
The candidate remains in an active or waiting state rather than CLOSED_NEGATIVE.
At least one substantive progress signal exists: a required gate PASS, or an explicit next decisive question, blocker, dependency, WAITING_FOR_DATA, or WAITING_FOR_RESULT state.
ground_truth_resolution_policy.priority: DECISIVE_NEGATIVE takes precedence over SURVIVOR when both could otherwise appear to apply.
ground_truth_resolution_policy.anti_zombie_rule: Mere age or repeated presence without a substantive progress signal is not sufficient for SURVIVOR.

pairing_rules: Baseline and challenger must use the captured case_id and frozen active_hour_id/task_shape metadata.
A side-specific observation cannot change candidate_id, task_shape, or representative task identity.
Missing side observations remain missing and cannot be imputed as zero or success.
No composite score is introduced; the existing shadow_acceptance.json replacement rule remains authoritative.
